head: 01f6f11
evidence_sources: official DeepSeek API docs (retrieved 2026-08-04): Chat Completions API, Models & Pricing, Thinking Mode guide, JSON Output guide
diagnostic probes A and B (frozen D0-01 essay, real credentials, direct calls)

proven_failure_chain.1: deepseek-v4-pro defaults to thinking mode (official docs: thinking default enabled) and the current production request omits the thinking toggle, so every structured-feedback request runs in thinking mode.
proven_failure_chain.2: In thinking mode the model first generates reasoning tokens; Probe A measured 1300 reasoning tokens of the 1800-token output budget (72%).
proven_failure_chain.3: The output budget (max_tokens=1800) is therefore exhausted before the JSON content is complete: Probe A returned finish_reason=length with completion_tokens exactly 1800.
proven_failure_chain.4: Incomplete JSON then fails StructuredFeedback parsing (D0: 'Invalid JSON: EOF while parsing'), triggering the router correction attempt.
proven_failure_chain.5: The correction attempt runs in the same thinking mode against a slightly larger prompt and a doubled budget; D0 measured a 30-second transport timeout on both correction attempts (initial attempt itself takes ~27s in thinking mode).
proven_failure_chain.6: ProviderRouter falls back to LocalDemo after the failed correction attempt (fallback_success).

evidence: official docs: thinking default enabled; current payload omits the toggle
Probe A (thinking on): finish_reason=length, 1300/1800 reasoning tokens, 27.05s
Probe B (thinking disabled, everything else identical): finish_reason=stop, 764/1800 completion tokens, 0 reasoning tokens, 10.85s, complete JSON
Probe A: completion_tokens=1800=requested max_tokens with finish_reason=length (official truncation signal)
Probe B shows 764 tokens suffice when thinking is disabled, so the 1800 budget is adequate only in non-thinking mode
Per DP0-A classification rules, finish_reason=length plus usage reaching the configured limit proves budget involvement in the truncation mechanism
D0: both correction attempts timed out at the 30s limit
Probe A initial attempt took 27.05s under thinking mode - within 30s but with no headroom; correction attempts add input and output
Probe B took 10.85s, showing the timeout problem disappears when thinking is disabled
Request sends response_format={"type":"json_object"}
System prompt explicitly instructs one JSON object matching required_schema (official JSON Output requirement)
Probe B proves the identical request shape produces valid complete JSON in non-thinking mode
Correction request total is ~54,950 chars vs initial ~54,446 chars (+~1%)
D0 correction timeouts are explained by thinking-mode latency, not prompt size
Transport is stdlib urllib; no SDK version compatibility applies
Direct probes returned HTTP 200 with valid response envelopes
Probes A and B both returned HTTP 200 with consistent system fingerprints
Failures track request settings, not service availability
The full StructuredFeedback JSON schema is embedded in the user payload (prompt_tokens 14,949)
Probe B produced a complete JSON object with 764 tokens, so the schema is output-producible
No isolated schema-size factor test was run; not needed because thinking-mode disable restores completion
json.loads and StructuredFeedback.model_validate_json correctly reject genuinely truncated content (D0)
The same parser accepts complete content (fallback path and probe B JSON parse success)
No parser bug reproduces on complete input

primary_root_cause: DeepSeek thinking mode runs by default (official default enabled) and the production request never disables it; reasoning tokens consume 72% of the 1800-token output budget, producing finish_reason=length truncation that fails StructuredFeedback validation, and thinking-mode latency pushes the correction attempt past the 30-second transport timeout.

answers.B_unintentional_thinking_mode: YES - PROVEN (default enabled; toggle omitted; Probe B restores completion)
answers.D_30s_timeout_too_short: YES for thinking-mode requests - PROVEN CONTRIBUTING (27.05s initial; correction timed out at 30s in D0)
answers.E_correction_attempt_slower: NO - RULED_OUT (correction prompt is ~1% larger; slowness comes from thinking mode)
answers.F_json_mode_request_compliance: COMPLIANT - RULED_OUT as a failure cause
answers.G_minimal_change_3_consecutive_successes: DP0-B acceptance criterion; not assessed in DP0-A

probe_b_validation_note: Probe B proves complete JSON generation (finish_reason=stop, parse success). Full StructuredFeedback schema validation of live output is an explicit DP0-B acceptance criterion and was not asserted in DP0-A.
